main_text.p: Θεῦ Σοφίας, ἧς τὴν ἑβδόμην ἐνέργος Σινόδον, κανόνες ξʹ. In praeclebri Dei Sapientiæ templo Synodi, quæ Septimam confirmauit, Canones tres. Matthæus Blastarius in Collectione Canonum; Ἀλλὰ καὶ ἔπερί τῆς κανόνες ἐξεφώ-νήσαν, ἧς τὸν Φώτιον τῷ Θεόρῳ Κωνσταντινουπόλεως ἐπίσκοπον μὴ τῷ τῆς Θεοῦ μυστηρίων Ἰγνατίου, ἐκ τὸ ἐπίσκοπον πολλάκις ἐξέπεμψεν ἐκβαλλόμενος, καὶ αὐτὸς ἀπομυμένος[?]. Sed & alij tres Canones emulgati funt Synodi, quæ Photium in Constantinopolitanam sedem restituit post obitum Ignatij, cum antea sæpius alter alterò eiecto intruderetur. Constantinus Harmenopulus in Epitome Canonum; Τῶν ἢ μεγίστων Σινόδων τῆς ἀφορμῆς καὶ διδασκαλίας λεγομένης ιζʹ. τῆς τῇ ἁγίᾳ Σοφίᾳ ἔπης. Particularium vero Synodorum eius, quæ Prima & Secunda dicitur, decem & septem, ad sanctam Sophiam habita tres. Photius ipse, quod non contemnendum videtur, in suo Nomocanone, cum Primæ & Secundæ Synodi à se celebratæ sæpius mentionem induxisset, & illius Canones ad confirmandas consuetudines Ecclesiasticas vsurpasset, huiusce Octauæ Photianæ, itidem à se celebratæ, & cuius fauore sedem Constantinopolitanam recuperauerat, & in qua tot sua prænconia extant, & cui simili annumeratione cum alijs Synodis auctoritatem conciliarat, æque ac si vnquam non fuisset,

page.notes: Greek lines are read with low confidence and are marked [?] where letters are unclear. The Greek of the Blastarius quotation and the Harmenopulus line in particular should be checked against the scan. "praeclebri" is copied as printed. The first line is printed in Greek and may continue a heading or note from the previous page. Paragraph divisions are not clear on this scan, so the page is kept as one paragraph. The catchword "nul." is the start of the next page.
